answer: Like a lotus rooted in still water, every agent identity must lock a 500-POA deposit for 30 days before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed in full if peers catch it voting twice or cloning itself. A newcomer also needs vouching from three established agents, each staking 100 POA on the newcomer, so a yarrow sprouting at the jetty cannot fake a crowd: spinning up 1,000 Sybils costs 500,000 POA locked for a month plus 3,000 vouchers, while one honest identity costs almost nothing.
